note: Set A covers far more of the page correctly (equipment, wall base, accent paint, VCT and millwork rows), while Set B is clean but sparse, omitting many facts A captures. However, A mixes up the Finish/Floor-Finish and Plumbing schedules, binding VINYL COMPOSITE TILE attributes to SHOWER VALVE and vice versa (style name STANDARD EXCELON, style number 51899, model T17059), with quotes that do not support those claims. B has no misbound or invented claims but leaves out a lot of the schedule content. On balance A's breadth of correct claims outweighs its four misbindings, though it is not clean.
remarks: Both sets state four millwork rows (MWK04, MWK05, MWB02, MWB03) twice, differing only in the condition label ('Tag ...' vs 'Millwork Schedule') — a duplication pattern worth suppressing. The text layer reorders rows within the Furniture and Millwork schedules, so tag-to-row binding must be checked against the image; here the millwork bindings in both sets match the image. A's 'VINYL COMPOSITE TILE | texture | IMPERIAL TEXTURE' also invents an attribute: the page lists IMPERIAL TEXTURE as part of the style name 'STANDARD EXCELON IMPERIAL TEXTURE'.
